text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any plans for tomorrow's day 
off, Sky-san?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow I'm going boat fishing~♪ I caught 
a ton last time I went, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry. You just startled me. 
...Because... of what happened last time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ? What happened?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You know, hugging Grass, and giving me a 
wall sla— ...C-Cornering me against the 
wall.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
............Aahh~! Right, right, that 
totally happened, didn't it!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha☆ So sorry about that~! I only 
meant to tease you a bit, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how flustered you got, Dober-san, 
was just too funny... so I couldn't help 
myself♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What!? Does that mean... ...you weren't 
actually sleepwalking at all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~... Geez. Keep your pranks in 
moderation, alright?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I won't do it again, so forgive me, 
please~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You... could it be that you're feeling 
unwell?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because... for someone as contrary as you 
to reveal your schemes and apologize so 
easily...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Ehh~, that's mean. Even I apologize 
sometimes, you know.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, perhaps. However—whenever you do, 
there's always an ulterior motive.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No no, you're overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
See! Usually you would say something 
like... "King, do you want me to play a 
prank on you too, nya~?" ...or something 
along those lines!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The more I think about it, the 
weirder you are today. Or is there... some 
other reason—?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~~... Now that you mention it, I'm 
feeling so dizzy~~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
!? I knew it! Goodness, go to the nurse's 
office right this instant!

One day on the train, I spotted Seiun Sky 
standing next to her fishing gear. She 
wore a rather solemn expression, but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Oho~, I wondered whose gaze that was. 
Did Sei-chan in her boat fishing gear 
completely captivate you?
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking about how delicious 
that fish you gave me was.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah—... Ahaha, yeah... I gotta be careful 
in more ways than one.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, nope, just talking to myself~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
! Ahaha, I see we have a foodie on our 
hands!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's true enough. If I keep 
brooding over the past, I won't catch a 
single thing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
For my dear foodie's sake, I'll be sure to 
bring back a big catch again♪
